name: QR Code Generator
summary: Generate a QR code from any text or URL and download it as PNG or SVG — all in your browser.
description: Create QR codes for links, Wi‑Fi notes, contact strings, or plain text. Choose error-correction level and size, then download PNG or SVG. Generation runs entirely on your device.

faqs.question: Is my content uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The QR code is generated entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What does error correction mean?
faqs.answer: Higher levels (Q/H) survive more damage or logo overlays but pack less data into the same size. M is a good default.

faqs.question: PNG or SVG?
faqs.answer: PNG is ready for sharing and printing at the chosen pixel size. SVG scales cleanly for design tools.
